transcript_only_text:
Sadness  comes  from  a  lack  of  options, 
 which  is  why  it  feels  like  hopelessness. 
 Anxiety  comes  from  many  options,  but  a 
 lack  of  priorities,  which  is  why  it 
 feels  like  paralysis.  And  so,  you  solve 
 sadness  with  knowledge,  and  anxiety  with 
 a  decision.  And  so,  if  you  don't  know 
 what  to  do,  you  have  to  find  out  what  to 
 do.  And  so,  decision  solves  anxiety, 
 knowledge  solves  sadness.
